description: This file defines the interface 'InterestRateChartSlabWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting interest rate chart slabs within the system.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface for services that handle write operations (create, update, delete) related to interest rate chart slabs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new interest rate chart slab using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing interest rate chart slab identified by chartSlabId and interestChartId with data from JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteChartSlab
methods.description: Deletes the specified chart slab associated with the given interest rate chart.
